methodology: Statistical A/B testing with minimum sample size calculation

tests.name: Improve Meta Descriptions for Search Visibility
tests.hypothesis: If we write optimized meta descriptions (70-160 chars, action-oriented), click-through rate from search results will increase by 10%, because better descriptions entice more clicks.

scenario.control: Current: Generic or missing meta descriptions
scenario.variant: Optimized: 120-char descriptions with action words (e.g., "Shop premium sneakers...")

tests.name: Fix Missing/Multiple H1 Tags for SEO
tests.hypothesis: If we ensure exactly one H1 per page with target keyword, search ranking visibility will improve by 8%, because H1s are critical SEO signals & help screen readers.

scenario.control: Current: Missing or multiple H1 tags
scenario.variant: Fixed: Single H1 with primary keyword, positioned near top of content

tests.success_criteria: >8% increase in search impressions or +0.5 avg position improvement

tests.name: Add Alt Text to Missing Product Images
tests.hypothesis: If we add descriptive alt text to all images, accessibility score improves & image search traffic increases by 5%, because alt text helps both users & search engines.

scenario.control: Current: Missing alt attributes on images
scenario.variant: Fixed: Descriptive alt text (context + keyword): "Blue Air Jordan 1 High-Top Sneakers"

tests.success_criteria: >5% increase in image search traffic or +10 accessibility score points

implementation_notes: Use localStorage to assign variants consistently per user
Track all conversions with analytics events
Run tests simultaneously to reduce total test duration
Use Google Analytics 4 custom events for tracking
Minimum 4 weeks per test at current traffic levels
